projects.title: Legacy Assistant
projects.description: RAG-based scalable AI assistant that collects data and voice recordings from individuals, enabling the assistant to emulate the person's responses and interactions with loved ones after their passing. Includes cost monitoring, self-harm detection, and disaster recovery.

projects.title: Sales Maximizing
projects.description: AI-driven inventory optimization system that minimizes inventory costs while reducing loss orders due to stockout from vendor lead times. Includes scheduled model training and monitoring pipelines.

projects.title: Traffic Diagnostic Tool
projects.description: Orchestrated traffic monitoring tool designed to detect and analyze anomalies in web traffic patterns in real-time.

projects.title: Parenting Application
projects.description: Image classifier with 99% accuracy detecting games played by children, with parent notification for unlisted games. AI chat system detects violations or bullying with 96% accuracy.

projects.title: Techjays AI Chatbot
projects.description: RAG-based personalized AI chatbot that assists users and clients with desired information. Built with Django REST API for frontend integration.

projects.title: Cost Reduction for Custom LLMs
projects.description: Reduced operational costs by 50% through efficient algorithms and resource optimization for open-source Large Language Models in NLP projects.

projects.title: CV Summarization Tool
projects.description: CV summarization and candidate ranking system using NLP techniques, leading to a 45% reduction in manual screening time.

projects.title: Web-Based KYC & Facial Recognition
projects.description: Web-based Know Your Customer (KYC) system incorporating liveness checking and facial recognition technology, achieving 95% accuracy in facial recognition for secure user verification.

projects.title: Data Visualization from Embedded Systems
projects.description: Pioneered real-time data visualization on the web by creating data streams from embedded systems processing local IP camera feeds.

projects.title: Object Detection Model (Fire & Smoke)
projects.description: Fire-smoke detection model with 98% accuracy, demonstrating feasibility and potential applications of the technology while reducing false positives by 15%.
